FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Building Window Change
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Lets the player optionally view buildings that they haven't yet unlocked through research.

patchNoteLines.li: Augments the building window with a toggle to show buildings that are locked by research or tech level

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event Bugfix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes for Wanderlust and Settling Down events.

patchNoteLines.li: Fixes faction-level stat calculations to actually take faction-level events into account.
Adds 'MayRequire' guards for the Odyssey DLC on all defs/xml patches for space stuff

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: ResourceTypeDef update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Small change to allow resources to be set as non-titheable, even if they aren't pool resources.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a canTithe field to ResourceTypeDef. If false, the resource cannot be tithed.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Cache Bugfix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a niche case where the static cache wouldn't be invalidated.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a postfix onto Game.ClearCache to clear Empire's caches, in addition to the current Game.Dispose patch

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor tech level change
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Small change to how the Empire faction's tech level is calculated.

patchNoteLines.li: Uses the player faction's tech level as a floor when determining the Empire faction's tech level. Meant to provide compatibility with techlevel-advancing mods.
Add a raidTargetingWeight field to WorldSettlementDef. Influences how likely settlements of that type are to be raided
Slight rewrite of the raid-targeting logic to include the above field and also make use of RandomElementByWeight
Add two functions to FCEventHandlerExtension to let events have dynamic odds of success
Add IsOptionAvailable to FCEventHandlerExtension to let events dynamically determine if an option is available

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor UI Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes the main tab window to always show pool resources.

patchNoteLines.li: Always show pool resources on the main tab window, even if they are 0

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Faction Trait Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: The Innovative trait's functionality was lost in a recent refactor; this patch adds it back in.

patchNoteLines.li: Re-add Innovative's functionality
Actually implement the Lucky trait...

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Policy Description Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Handful of minor fixes for policy descriptions.

patchNoteLines.li: Added displayDivisor field to FCStatDef
FCStatModifier descriptions will divide stat values by their displayDivisor if displayDivisor is non-zero
raidCooldownOffset and deadPawnCooldownOffset have 2500 displayDivisor (so they will show up in-game as hours instead of ticks)
Handful of grammar and clarity fixes

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor backend changes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Minor backend change to the static cache invalidation.

patchNoteLines.li: Publicizes the EmpireCacheUtil class and adds two functions for submods to "register" themselves, so that their global caches are automatically invalidated at the same time as Empire's

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Settle Colony fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a couple of checks and validations for the settle colony event.

patchNoteLines.li: Wraps the settleNewColony portion of Process Events in a try/catch, so we can remove the target location from the caravans list if the event fails somehow
Adds new ValidateSettlementCaravansList function, firing daily to make sure that the settlementCaravansList has no orphaned locations
